lessons.symptom: A non-format local read failure was presented as an empty state that could accept a new goal.
lessons.cause: The controller distinguished corrupt data but collapsed ordinary storage exceptions into the no-data state.
lessons.proposed_change: Add a factory checklist item that transient local-load failures must remain write-locked until retry or explicit recovery.
lessons.regression_check: A repository load exception renders Retry, creates no goal, and records zero save calls before a successful reload.

lessons.symptom: The initial icon rasterizer produced valid-size PNG files while silently omitting SVG curve paths; an earlier generation also produced invalid Android filenames.
lessons.cause: Asset generation validated file existence and dimensions but not exact output names or rendered visual content.
lessons.proposed_change: Require exact asset-catalog filenames, alpha inspection, and human viewing of both the 1024 icon and one small raster before release preflight.
lessons.regression_check: Android resource merge passes, the 1024 PNG has no alpha, and both large and 180px renders visibly contain every intended segment.
